query: What is the refund policy for digital products?
How long does standard shipping take?
Can I get a refund if I cancel my subscription right after being charged?
What happens if my package is lost?
Create a high priority ticket titled 'Damaged shipment' with description 'Customer received order #4521 with a crushed box and a broken item inside, requesting a replacement.'
notes: Action intent creates a real MCP side effect (a ticket). Excluded from a default run so evaluate.py doesn't spam the ticketing system on every CI run; pass --include-actions to execute it. The query is fully specified (title, description, priority) on purpose — a single-turn ReAct agent will correctly ask clarifying questions instead of acting on an underspecified request, which is desired behavior but fails a one-shot eval; this query gives it everything it needs up front.
